verdict.rationale: Weave's trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that serves as a runnable in-page console against the production API. It is backed by a complete OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (117 paths), and the hosted endpoint reference pages add a per-endpoint "Try it" playground. Together these deliver an interactive API reference with runnable examples. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Try-it/Swagger consoles, and a working spec link from the docs site (the docs-listed spec and the candidate paths probed on docs.wandb.ai return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The trace API hosts a live Swagger UI that loads /openapi.json, a runnable in-page console against the production API
The hosted endpoint reference pages on docs.coreweave.com additionally render a "Try it" API playground per endpoint
